scope: Original project process sources only. Not executable deployment material.
redaction_policy: Remove host home paths and device serials
Replace UUIDs, IPv4 addresses, MAC addresses, 32-character identifiers and 64-character hash pins with non-authorizing placeholders
Quarantine credential-shaped literals without copying their contents
Exclude third-party source trees, generated outputs, device evidence, bind manifests, firmware and binaries
Current OpenClash and system-switch components are published separately
deduplication: SHA256 over sanitized UTF-8 bytes; original relative source paths retained in records
